headline: Clinton order amends an earlier 1995 order that set pay rates and allowances for members of the uniformed services.
what_it_does: This order changes Executive Order 12984, which had set pay rates and allowances for the uniformed services. Based on the title, it adjusts those pay or allowance figures. No summary was provided, so the exact changes are not known from this source.

who_it_affects.group: Members of the uniformed services (such as the military, Public Health Service, and NOAA Corps)
who_it_affects.how: Their pay rates or allowances may be adjusted by this amendment.
